_doc: Sources whose changes can alter how this build behaves or what it should do. Checked daily by scripts/watch_sources.py; changes land in Cody/watch/ (private). Adding a source = one entry here. 'why' says what in THIS build it can affect; 'on_change' says what to do.

sources.name: iOS & iPadOS release notes (Apple)
sources.why: Cody reads the hub almost only in Safari on iPhone (iOS 27.2 beta at time of writing); Mail notifications, VIP/Focus rules and Siri behaviour live here.
sources.on_change: Read the new notes for Safari/WebKit, Mail, notifications, Focus and Siri items; rerun the phone probe on the hub and dashboard.

sources.name: Safari release notes (Apple)
sources.why: Rendering engine for every page Cody sees: CSS (color-mix, :is, grid), fonts, fetch, scroll behaviour.
sources.on_change: Check deprecations and CSS changes against build_hub.py / dashboard_template.html; rerun phone_probe.py.

sources.name: macOS release notes (Apple)
sources.why: The Mac runs live_server, the launchd jobs, osascript -> Mail (report sending), and the system Python.
sources.on_change: Look for launchd, AppleScript/Mail scripting, TCC/automation permission and Command Line Tools/Python changes; run the mail preview and launchctl list.

sources.name: Python release/EOL schedule
sources.why: The project targets the system Python 3.9 (CLAUDE.md). EOL affects security fixes and library support.
sources.on_change: If 3.9 support ends or the system Python changes, plan an upgrade decision for Cody.

sources.name: Tailscale releases
sources.why: Cody's phone reaches the hub only through Tailscale Serve (ts.net host trusted by live_server).
sources.on_change: Check Serve/HTTPS/MagicDNS changes; confirm the ts.net URL still loads.

sources.name: ncaa-api (henrygd) — the scores/box feed proxy
sources.why: Every score, box score and poll comes through this API; endpoint or schema changes break the crawl silently.
sources.on_change: Read the commits; run test_crawl_freshness and a one-date crawl check.

sources.name: ncaavolleyballr (CRAN) — play-by-play dataset
sources.why: Source of 2025 rally data (rotations, serve-receive); a new season's data would unlock rally features.
sources.on_change: Check for 2026 play-by-play availability and license.

sources.name: GitHub changelog (Actions, Pages)
sources.why: The nightly and 20-minute jobs run on GitHub Actions; the public page is on GitHub Pages.
sources.on_change: Check runner image / Python / cron / Pages changes against .github/workflows.

sources.name: GitHub Actions runner images
sources.why: ubuntu-latest image changes (Python version, tools) can break the workflows.
sources.on_change: Look for ubuntu-latest Python changes; watch the next nightly run.

sources.name: Google Workspace / Gmail updates
sources.why: Report emails send as wvbhub.desk@gmail.com through Mail.app (IMAP/SMTP); Google has disabled this account twice.
sources.on_change: Check whether the change affects third-party mail clients or app passwords; run a mail preview.

sources.name: Claude Code releases
sources.why: The Builder seat runs on Claude Code (hooks, permissions, auto mode).
sources.on_change: Read release notes for hook/permission/tool changes affecting .claude/hooks and the workflow.
